blocks.text: 45 minutes is perfect, thank you. Here's what I'll bring:
How the Balcony App works offline today: an inspector can start, fill in and save a full inspection with no signal.
What a signed report could look like.
Schema Bridge in a sentence: a shared format so inspections can move from Balcony to where they need to go, without anyone typing them in twice.
Mostly, though, I'd love to hear how a yard inspection actually goes for your team, start to finish. That's the part I can't learn from a website.
